resources.string: DNS-only rules on this device. Every saved change and backup requires the parent PIN. These controls do not start the VPN or bypass Android permissions.

Parent rules are authoritative: parent allows, then parent blocks. For remaining queries: permanent or unexpired local allow → custom deny → app block → category block → default allow. Profiles only add app/category blocks; overlaps combine. They never disable base or parent rules.
Use ASCII/punycode, not a URL. Exact patterns match only that host. *.example.com matches subdomains at any depth, but not example.com. An allow can override overlapping local denies and app blocks.

Timed allows expire at an absolute instant, including while the app is closed. Restoring a backup does not renew them. Changing a device clock changes expiry evaluation. Replacing an identical permanent allow with a timed allow removes that permanent entry; other overlapping allows still apply. Expired entries stay visible until removed.
Remove %1$s from this local list? Other matching rules and parent rules still apply.

Schedules use the current device time zone and wall clock. Start is inclusive; end is exclusive. Selected weekdays are the START days: Sunday 22:00–06:00 continues into Monday. Equal times are invalid. DST skipped minutes do not run; repeated minutes run twice. Clock/zone changes apply on the next intercepted DNS query, without alarms. Existing DNS caches or connections are not revoked.

Optional app UIDs, separated by commas or spaces

Advanced: use Android app UIDs, not package names. Shared UIDs affect every app sharing that UID. Unknown UID −1 is not selectable. Recheck UIDs after reinstalling apps or restoring on another device. At least one category or UID is required; up to 1,000 UID references across profiles.
Delete local profile “%1$s”? Base rules, other profiles and parent rules are unchanged.
Saved rules loaded. Tap a profile to edit it. Status is evaluated at refresh.
Enter an exact domain or a leading *. wildcard with at least two valid ASCII/punycode labels, not a URL.
Enter a whole number of minutes from 1 to 10080.
Choose a name, at least one weekday, different start/end times and at least one category or valid UID.
Could not save. Check duplicate profile names, a removed profile, the 8-profile/1,000-entry limits and the 256 KB backup limit. Previous saved rules are unchanged.
Could not read local rules. No rules were changed. Keep your existing backup.

Version 2 includes denies, absolute allow expiries and schedules. Version 1 backups still import, with these new lists empty. Import replaces all local rules, not parent rules, PIN, pairing or history. Export shares a new cache file without overwriting older exports; save a copy outside the app for a durable backup.

Replace all local rules with the selected backup? Version 1 clears custom denies, timed allows and profiles. Parent rules, PIN, pairing and history are not changed. Invalid files leave saved rules unchanged.
